reasons: cash_balance is 0.00 and the activation synthesis runs on the pay-as-you-go key, which is the only key type the platform charges 账户余额 for (M Plan FAQ: 'Your account balance is charged only when you use a pay-as-you-go API Key'). An approved charge is not a payable charge. Whether voucher_balance can fund a pay-as-you-go charge is UNKNOWN -- no official page reached states it -- and automatic voucher consumption, automatic recharge and automatic Credit Pack use are all forbidden. This gate therefore does NOT move on the same evidence that cleared the Subscription-Key TTS gate.
the CNY 9.90 first-activation fee has not been recorded as authorised in this run. The Founder's standing authorisation covers the clone fee only; it does not extend to additional character spend.

the activation synthesis itself is a billable TTS request: 44 billable characters at 3.50 CNY/10k, estimated CNY 0.015400. This is recorded as FIRST_ACTIVATION_TTS_FEE_UNKNOWN and must not be assumed zero. It is separate from the CNY 9.90 voice fee and needs its own authorisation.

the vendor confirmation states an activated voice may be synthesised with the M Plan key, but that is an account-level commercial statement and not an API-level permission grant. No official source confirms a voice_id created under a pay-as-you-go key can synthesise under the Subscription Key; get_voice listing is account-scoped and proves visibility, not usability, and error 2042 (无权访问该 voice_id) is the documented symptom if visibility does not imply usability. Must not be claimed as supported before one real synthesis answers it.

official_basis.page: platform.minimax.cn/docs/pricing/overview (音色管理 / 快速复刻)
official_basis.fact: 9.90 元/音色, 按量计费. 复刻音色时不立即收费, 首次使用该音色进行合成时才计入. 试听字符按所选试听模型的单价计费.
可用模型覆盖 MiniMax 全系模型(M3 / M2.7 / 图像 / 语音), 少量特殊模型(MiniMax H3、音色设计、快速复刻等)暂不支持.
积分与 Token Plan 覆盖相同资源; 若同一用量可由套餐内额度和积分覆盖, 优先使用套餐内额度.
通过充值获得的 API Key 与 Token Plan API Key 相互独立, 且不可互换. 使用开放平台 API Key 调用, 按实际用量消耗账户余额.

同步语音合成 T2A speech-2.8-hd = 3.50 元/万字符. 计费项是字符数,以 10000 个字符(输入)为单位,1 个汉字算 2 个字符,英文字母、希腊字母、标点符号、特殊符号、空格、回车等算 1 个字符. Used to compute the activation synthesis's character cost, which is a separate billable item from the CNY 9.90 voice fee.

A Subscription Key only uses your M Plan usage and credit packs. When you reach your usage limit, any remaining credit pack balance is used next. Your account balance is charged only when you use a pay-as-you-go API Key. 排他性表述: 套餐内额度 -> 积分包, 不含代金券, 不含账户余额. This is the basis on which a non-zero voucher_balance no longer blocks a Subscription-Key in-plan speech request, and equally the basis on which it STILL blocks the pay-as-you-go-key activation charge.
